seoTitle: Fix "No Delivery Available" Error at Shopify Checkout
metaDescription: Customers seeing "No Delivery Available" at checkout? Learn how to fix shipping zones, delivery profiles, and product settings causing the error in Shopify.
intro: The "No Delivery Available" error at Shopify checkout stops customers from completing their purchase, often because of a shipping configuration issue rather than anything wrong with the order itself. This guide covers the main causes and how to fix them so checkout works again.

steps.heading: Check your shipping zones
steps.body: Review your shipping zones in Shopify Admin to confirm the customer's location is actually included in a zone with an available rate.

steps.heading: Review delivery profiles
steps.body: Missing or misconfigured delivery profiles can leave certain products without a valid shipping option, so check that every product is assigned to a profile.

steps.heading: Match product weight and location settings
steps.body: Confirm that product weights and origin locations are set correctly, since mismatches here can cause Shopify to fail to calculate a delivery rate.

steps.heading: Check store address and location settings
steps.body: Make sure your store's shipping origin address is properly configured, as errors here can prevent rates from generating at all.

steps.heading: Test checkout after making changes
steps.body: Run a test checkout to a few different addresses to confirm delivery options now appear and the error is resolved.

faq.question: Why does "No Delivery Available" appear for only some customers?
faq.answer: It's often because their shipping address falls outside your configured shipping zones or because a specific product lacks a valid delivery profile.

faq.question: Can incorrect product weight cause this error?
faq.answer: Yes, if weight or dimensions are missing or unrealistic, Shopify may be unable to calculate a shipping rate and will show no delivery options.

faq.question: Do I need a shipping app to fix this?
faq.answer: Not necessarily — many cases are fixed directly through Shopify's built-in shipping zone and delivery profile settings without needing a third-party app.

faq.question: How do I know which setting is causing the error?
faq.answer: Testing checkout with different addresses and products helps narrow down whether the issue is zone-based, profile-based, or tied to a specific product.
